items.stem: A learner is studying the 'Organizational structures and master data' domain of the SAP S/4HANA Sales syllabus. Which statement best describes the purpose of this domain within the overall exam scope?

options.text: It establishes the foundational structures and concepts that later domains build on
options.rationale: Correct: the first domain sets up the structures and vocabulary the remaining domains depend on. (Illustrative sample; confirm against the official outline.)

options.text: It is an optional appendix that is not assessed
options.rationale: Incorrect: all published in-scope domains are assessable; none is an unassessed appendix.

options.text: It replaces the need to study every other domain
options.rationale: Incorrect: each domain is assessed on its own objectives; one domain does not substitute for others.

options.text: It only covers vendor marketing material
options.rationale: Incorrect: the domain covers examinable technical/professional objectives, not marketing.

items.explanation: Correct: the first domain sets up the structures and vocabulary the remaining domains depend on.

items.stem: Within the SAP S/4HANA Sales preparation course, how is a learner's progress judged on this platform?

options.text: By passing the official external examination inside this platform
options.rationale: Incorrect: the external exam is sat with the issuer, not on this platform; this course does not award the credential.

options.text: By meeting Mastemy learning thresholds (module checks >= 75%, final >= 80%)
options.rationale: Correct: platform completion uses Mastemy learning thresholds, which are not the issuer's pass mark.

options.text: By watching every video regardless of assessment scores
options.rationale: Incorrect: watching videos alone does not meet the completion rule; the module and final thresholds must be met.

options.text: By the platform predicting the learner's scaled exam score
options.rationale: Incorrect: platform scores do not predict scaled exam scores.

items.explanation: Correct: platform completion uses Mastemy learning thresholds, which are not the issuer's pass mark.
